messages:
Anika: FYI I'm starting the shrinkwrap + archive build for the private installer 1.4.8 tonight. Targeting a VPC delivery window 22:00-23:30 UTC. Need agreement on pin strategy, cosign signer, and rollback gates.

Raj: ack. Do we have the new signer key staged? I thought KMS rotation was next week.

Marta: We can use the existing signer but will add a secondary cosign identity for the transport bundle, per compliance. Will upload to signer queue in 30m.

Owen: Can we avoid a full rebuild if only packaging metadata changed? If yes, prefer shrinkwrap (delta) so mirrors don't need full re-pull.

Anika: Yes, shrinkwrap delta. Only packaging + small hotfix in installer scripts. No model artifact changes. Delta size ~120MB estimated.

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary job queued -> private-installer/1.4.8-delta canary (3 customers)

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary started at 1719502234 against vpc-cust-{alpha,beta,gamma} ; expected ~30m monitoring

Raj: For rollback rules: if any canary customer reports installer failing post-install with exit code != 0 or checksum mismatch on transit, we abort and repin to 1.4.7. Also watch TLS handshake errors from bridge-proxy.

Marta: adding explicit checksum validation step + verification logs to the installer: run at verify stage: 
```
sha256sum /opt/redwood/installer-bundle.tar.gz
# expected: 3f8a1c9b7d2e4a6b0f...
```
Will post the exact hash when packaging completes.

Owen: Also need cosign verification snippet in the install docs so on-prem teams can run: 
```
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/rg-keys/installer-signer  registry.company/private/installer:1.4.8
```

Anika: Change window: 22:00 UTC start. Canary completes by 22:40. If signals green, staged rollout 22:50 -> 23:30 with 15min stagger. If any critical error before 23:00 we stop and rollback.

SRE-Bot: perf-alert: observed transient increase in bridge-proxy TCP retries during first canary run +2.3% (rollout watch).

Raj: Noted. Which metric exactly? latency or retries? If retries > 1% absolute we pause.

SRE-Bot: metric: bridge_proxy.tcp_retries (percent) baseline 0.5% -> 2.8% during first 5 min of canary.

Marta: hmm that might be noisy due to canary traffic spike. Put a short hold and re-run canary traffic generator to reproduce.

Anika: Action items: Marta posts cosign hash + installer SHA by 21:45 UTC; Raj monitors bridge metrics, Owen confirms shrinkwrap delta artifacts staged to offsite mirrors; I'll coordinate canary customers and the deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary step paused (manual) at 1719502860 by Anika

Anika: Paused to validate cosign and retry bridge probe. Marta please re-upload signer and paste verification outputs here.

Marta: Uploader: cosign key uploaded to KMS path projects/rg-keys/installer-signer. Cosign output: 
```
$ cosign sign --key k8s://projects/rg-keys/installer-signer registry.company/private/installer:1.4.8
Signature uploaded: sha256:3f8a1c9b7d2e4a6b0f...
```
Installer SHA256: 3f8a1c9b7d2e4a6b0fa7d5c9b8e6f1a2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f

Owen: Mirrors: delta bundle uploaded to s3://redwood-offline/deltas/1.4.8-delta.tar.gz (size 127MB). Manifest: registry-offline-manifest-1.4.8.json posted to staging bucket.

Raj: Re-ran bridge probe script against canary nodes: 
```
$ ./bridge_probe.sh vpc-cust-alpha
probe OK latency 22ms retries 0
```
Second run shows retries back to baseline. Might have been transient. Recommend resume canary.

Anika: resume canary please. Also note rollback criteria: 
- checksum mismatch at install verify (immediate abort)
- installer exit code >=1 with payload corruption logs (abort)
- bridge_proxy.tcp_retries > 1.5% sustained for 10m (pause + investigate)
- any data-plane auth error for KMS at signing step (abort)

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary resumed at 1719503120 by Anika

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary completed at 1719503720 -> 3/3 canaries succeeded.

Marta: Post-canary checks: cosign verify output: 
```
$ cosign verify --key k8s://projects/rg-keys/installer-signer registry.company/private/installer:1.4.8
Verified OK: sha256:3f8a1c9b7d2e4a6b0f...
```
Installer SHA matches.

Owen: Mirrors checksum validated on 3 edge caches. TTL primed.

Anika: Given green canary, proceeding with staggered rollout. Reminder: if customers on the 22:50-23:05 batch have failures, we stop further batches and open rollback.

Raj: I'll keep a 30m watch and be ready to trigger rollback. Slack alarm set for bridge_proxy alerts.

SRE-Bot: notice: deployment-notes artifact uploaded to docs.s3: docs/private/1.4.8/release-notes.md

Anika: final note for release notes: add instructions for local cosign verification, shrinkwrap delta application steps, and explicit troubleshooting for TLS handshake errors with bridge-proxy.

Marta: Will update release notes and add a short snippet for offline installers to validate via: 
```
openssl s_client -connect bridge-proxy.company:443 -servername bridge-proxy.company
```

Owen: tagging the package in registry: registry.company/private/installer:1.4.8 -> pinned to repo:private/installer:stable-1.4

Anika: closing thread once rollout complete. Thanks all. :tada:
